summary: Lawler has consistently shielded Israel from accountability. As Middle East Subcommittee Chair he warned Hamas to 'Accept Peace or Face Devastating Consequences,' co-introduced H.Res. 1323 rejecting the UN's IDF child-rights listing, and pledged continued US military support for Israel in his 2026 campaign. He demanded an apology from Rep. Tlaib over the Al-Ahli Arab Hospital bombing, voted for and later sponsored IHRA-based Antisemitism Awareness Acts, and called the ceasefire a 'testament to America's unwavering partnership with Israel.'
